command:
kubectl api-resources -o name | while read -r resource; do
    echo "listing ${resource}..."
    kubectl get "${resource}" --all-namespaces -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.name}{"\n"}'
done
context: Exact visible loop discovers resource types then requests only .metadata.name for every namespace; includes ConfigMap/CronJob/Ingress/RBAC/ServiceAccount/Secret/ReplicaSet when API access permits. It prints no namespace column, so identifies names not namespace mapping; this is metadata preflight, not complete deletion simulation. Permission failures may leave inventory incomplete.
Default name kind is documented; containerized local does not establish disposable workloads.
Actual all-kind-cluster list covers default cluster kind.
Verbatim uppercase documented example token CLUSTER_NAME retained without substitution; cluster removal, not a container prune.
Omit documented optional NAME and flags groups; empty selector lists all k3d clusters including CLUSTER_NAME.
